name: Cusco
summary: Cusco, former capital of the Inca Empire at 3,400 meters above sea level, offers a spectacular historic center, an intense cultural scene and one of the best gateways to Machu Picchu. The cost of living is very low and the climate is mild and stable almost all year round, with a dry season from May to September ideal for working and exploring. The big determining factor is the altitude: the first days usually bring altitude sickness and lower performance, and healthcare and internet outside the main coworkings are more limited than in other South American cities.
